about: E06 out-of-domain aggregate analysis of the frozen v0 outliner (tag outliner-v0-frozen-2026-10-01 = 8498eb3; pipeline/ imported read-only). AGGREGATE ONLY: counts, shares, histograms and scorer totals; no gold node, heading, label or gold locator is recorded. Scorer rows are copied from runs/<cell>/score-whole.json; everything else is recomputed here from the outline files and the CBETA XML line records.
generated_by: experiments/E06-capability-sweep (scratchpad script ood_analysis.py, run with pipeline/.venv)

conventions.depth: outline 'level' (1 = top). Scorer per_depth rows are copied as the scorer wrote them.
conventions.start_line: locations.commentary.explained (= the self line in self-outlining mode), else root_text.start; ':offset' stripped
conventions.segmentation: line-level 'next-node' rule for gold and predictions alike: a line belongs to the deepest node whose start line is the last at or before it; largest_segment = the largest stretch of text with no finer division (the 'largest-leaf share'), as share of the file's own-edition lines and reading-text characters. pipeline_segmentation = the frozen pipeline's own char-level outlined-text.json for the same cell
conventions.boundary_F1: structure-agnostic diagnostic the scorer lacks: distinct predicted node start lines (any depth) vs distinct gold node start lines (any depth); t=0 exact line, t=1 within one line in CBETA XML document order; one-to-one (1-D two-pointer, optimal). chance_precision_uniform = share of the file's lines within t of a gold start line; chance_F_uniform = expected F of the same number of start lines drawn uniformly
conventions.line_depth_match: t=0 multiset match on (start line, level), ignoring parent path; line_only_node_multiset = the same on start line alone (cf. the scorer's locator-only, which is top-down)
conventions.leaked: tier1-markup / tier2-markup read the original XML whose cb:mulu type=科判 IS the gold: LEAKED diagnostics, not results

t1602_bug.description: Self-outlining mode requires explained positions to be non-decreasing among siblings. _self_mode_order repairs a violation only for an item that was listed but never entered (`and not c.entered`, line 750): it nulls that item's explained position. When the out-of-order item WAS entered (taken up in the text), nothing repairs it; the tier-2 outline then fails validation [sibling-order], pipeline.py:269-270 raises (tier2) and resolver.py:1215-1218 refuses the input outline (hybrid).

why_near_zero: tier 2 adds nothing: genre gate decision no-structure (title '楞嚴經集註'; 10 accepted announcements in 310630 characters (0.03 per 1,000); 0 glossator attributions (X曰：); 註 genre (R07 F2): the title marks a 註 and announcements are sparse); tier1 and tier2 outlines are identical (26 nodes, depth 4, 21 leaves) vs gold 2611 nodes, depth 28, 1505 leaves.

the body (tier-1 unit 7_1) is one leaf of 9357 lines (91.2% of lines) and 300157 characters (96.6% of characters, 7.5x MAX_TEXT_CHARS=40000); the resolver skips it ({'span longer than 40000 characters': 1}) and every one of the gold's 2611 nodes (1505 distinct start lines) starts inside it; the gold's first start line is 11 lines after the body's first line.
hybrid's 14 inferred nodes start in the front matter (11) and the printed chart unit 6_1 (3), none in the body; 0 of its 10 new start lines are gold start lines at t=0 or t=1.

the printed 科 chart (unit 6_1, 537 lines, 3466 characters) holds 0 gold start lines but 236 of the gold's 1533 distinct headings of 4+ characters verbatim (punctuation-insensitive), against 2 in the body text: the chart restates the gold's labels where no gold node sits.
